nodes.title: About this workflow
widgets_values:
## MiniMax-H3 continuation: three 5 s clips, one 15 s video
Each clip starts on the **Last Frame** of the clip before it. **Stitch Continuation Clips** joins them and drops the repeated seam frame (with matching audio).

Models and settings match the Oct 6 Pillars run (pruned FL2VA Q4_K_M GGUF, Qwen3-VL 32B GGUF, 4-step turbo LoRA, 768x1344, 124 frames per clip).

**Memory:** as one job, the three decoded clips stay in RAM next to H3. Run it on Comfy Cloud or a machine with more than 32 GB of RAM. On 32 GB, run each clip as its own job and stitch at the end.

**Keyframe switch:** on = Krea 2 makes the keyframe from Style + Keyframe scene; off = the Load Image keyframe is used and Krea never loads.
**Unload:** VRAM Debug unloads every model after the keyframe, before H3 starts. It frees VRAM; RAM is freed when ComfyUI's cache needs the space.
